reason: $24.99 to $29.99 a month for one supplement is a lot on my budget, and I can get plain magnesium for a few dollars. Sachets also mean more foil trash, and I forget my vitamins half the time anyway.
objection: It costs several times what I pay for magnesium now, and I would be paying extra for the foil sachet packaging, which I think is just more waste.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 for 30 days, or a bottle option without the sachets, with the lab report still shown for the batch.
